speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the Ancestral Circle (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.ancestral_circle).

nodes.text: A cairn at the heart of the island's circle, the stones cold from the Mere. 'Each bell a king; each king a giant once.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
